description: Extracts one article from a public news or blog page: headline (og:title or h1), author, published and modified times, description and the article body as Markdown. Reads the page you name only; paywalled text is not returned and body text depends on the page using <article> or <main>. Choose this tool for: Extracts one article from a public news or blog page. Close alternatives on this server: search_bbc_news_articles (BBC News top stories from the public BBC RSS feed); search_cnbc (CNBC top news from CNBC's public RSS feed).
